newsitem.title: CHILE: BellSouth Chile unit granted $100 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth Chile unit granted $100 mln loan.

text.p: U.S. telecom BellSouth Corp's Chilean unit has received a $100 million syndicated loan from a group of eight international banks led by Citibank, said general manager Jorge Bascur.
"This is the first time BellSouth in Chile has brought in finance in this way," said Bascur in a statement.
Around $70 million of the loan will be used to refinance short-term debt, said finance director Jose Luis Ibaibarriaga.
The remaining $30 million will be deposited with the Central Bank for a year to comply with the reserve requirement rules on foreign capital brought into Chile, he said.

BellSouth, one of two large U.S. telecoms operating in Chile, reported a first quarter loss this year of 42 million pesos compared with 1.3 billion pesos in the same period last year, said Ibaibarriaga.
"We have clearly improved our position in comparative terms in the market," he said.
"This reduction in the losses is the result of an internal rationalization plan which has cut costs associated with sales which have reached near equilibrium for the first time."
BellSouth is one of eight companies battling in Chile's highly competitive multicarrier long-distance telephone service. The firm also operates mobile telecom services.
